finding: Server TypedDeliberationSessionRegistry activates declaration only in AgentWebSocketHandler agent.register handler. Client publishes initial UNAVAILABLE registration before asynchronous adapter initialization, then sends only agent.presence when measured READY. Presence handler updates status but does not activate capability declarations. Registry consequently remains UNAVAILABLE.
remediation: Refresh authenticated registration when actual measured runtime readiness changes; preserve exact session/current-binding checks and acknowledgment token update. No API admission bypass.
